description.value:
The first time each turn you attack the creature marked by your Critical Analysis, you may gamble on the outcome by rolling a d6. Rolling 4 or higher grants you advantage on attack rolls against that creature until the start of your next turn; rolling 3 or lower instead gives that creature advantage on attack rolls against you until the start of your next turn.

The die you roll for this wager grows larger as you gain levels: a d8 at 9th level, a d10 at 13th level, and a d12 at 17th level.
